data.body:
**[P2] Keep locally synthesized operation boundaries on one clock**

This closes operations lacking a backend end timestamp on the invocation clock, but `onOperationStart` still records a missing-start fallback with `new Date()`. Virtual child contexts use this path, so a wall-clock step after invocation anchoring but before their start mixes epochs, producing zero/negative durations and potentially placing user spans outside their SDK parent. Store locally synthesized starts using `liveTimestamp()` while retaining supplied backend dates, and add a wall-step-before-start test.
